text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] KV-cache pressure detected in eu-west-1 — p99 streaming latency spike, auto-alerting SLO breach. paging eng-sre rotation. incidents-channel also notified :rotating_light:

ashley: ack, i'm oncall. seeing multiple customer reports about streaming stalls and long tail tokens.

maya: confirmed via dashboards — p95 ~420ms -> 1.7s, p99 ~3.6s -> 9.4s for chat-stream endpoints, spike started ~1975002000.

ben: quick note: error budget alerts triggered at 1975002103. top traces show huge time in kv-lookup/kv-prefill path, lots of evictions logged.

ashley: copying logs from the router:```
[1975002201] pod=gpt-serve-3 node=eu-west-1-3 kv-evict count=8243 free=18MB prefills=142 delay_ms=1200
[1975002202] pod=gpt-serve-7 node=eu-west-1-7 kv-evict count=9110 free=9MB prefills=8 delay_ms=2300
```

sam: looks like fragmentation + aggressive LRU due to a recent rollout of small-cache profile? any config rollouts in last 24h?

maya: there was a dedicate rollout 1974999000 that tightened per-model cache limits for cost reasons (quantized-128 profile). could be related.

ashley: mitigation plan options: 1) bump KV cache soft-limit on affected pool, 2) temporarily relax prefill policy (reduce prefill concurrency so decode path handles warmup), 3) fail-open to non-prefill decode path (slower but avoids stalls).

ben: customers impacted: ~4 high-traffic tenants in eu-west-1 streaming route — they report paused streams (stall until final token), so UX broken. revenue impact medium.

ops-bot: runbook snippet: set cache soft-limit via /ops/cachectl or patch config map. recommended: +30% soft-limit for 1h and monitor. non-disruptive.

ashley: executing option 1 as quick mitigation. running:```bash
opsctl patch pool eu-west-1-gpu --kv-soft-limit 1.3x --reason "mitigate kv-eviction spikes"
```

maya: while that's in flight, i'm going to throttle prefill concurrency on pods with high eviction counter to reduce read storms:```bash
kubectl -n inference annotate deployment gpt-serve-7 prefills.concurrency=2 --overwrite
```

sam: watch metrics: kv-evict-rate, kv-prefill-queue, kv-hit-ratio, stream-stall-count. also check tail-latency traces for decode vs kv-wait.

ben: adding quick grafana snapshots:
- kv-evict-rate: peaked at 6k/min at 1975002150
- kv-hit-ratio: dropped 0.97 -> 0.63
- stream-stall-count: +520 in 10m window

ashley: patch applied, opsctl returned success. nodes report new soft-limit applied, waiting for stabilization (rolling config push).

maya: prefill throttle applied to 3 pods. I also disabled aggressive prefix prefill for the quantized-128 profile:```yaml
model_profiles:
  quantized-128:
    prefill_enabled: false
```

sam: we should instrument a temporary metric for "kv-prefill-vs-decode-time" to verify imbalance, but that's follow-up. for now, any immediate improvement?

maya: initial numbers: p95 dropped from 1.7s -> 680ms within 90s of change, p99 from 9.4s -> 2.2s. stream-stall count down ~70%.

ben: nice. continue to monitor for next 30m. open action items: rollback cost-profile rollout to default for affected pool, add guardrails to avoid aggressive LRU on small caches, and add alert for kv-hit-ratio < 0.8 when eviction rate > 500/min.

ashley: noted. i'm posting interim customer update to support and account teams: "We're mitigating a KV cache pressure issue in eu-west-1 causing streaming stalls; we've applied an emergency config bump and prefill throttles. Latency improving, further monitoring ongoing."

ops-bot: incident-created: ID INC-1975-kv-prefill. severity: Sev2. assignees: ashley, maya. links: https://inc/INC-1975-kv-prefill

sam: quick root cause hypothesis: fragmentation from small per-model caches + prefill-heavy warmups created intense eviction storms; prefill produced I/O spikes that starved decode latency causing long-tail stalls.

maya: agree. follow-up tasks (owners):
- maya: revert quantized-128 aggressive limits and run canary with increased soft-limit (1h)
- ben: add eviction/fragmentation dashboard and alert (24h)
- ashley: customer comms and postmortem owner (72h)
- sam: instrument prefills to sample latency vs decode path (48h)

ashley: handing off to maya for next 2h. i'm removing myself from pager for now but reachable if needed. :wave:

maya: taking over oncall, will update thread every 15m. current status: mitigation applied, metrics trending better, svc at reduced error budget consumption.

ben: thumbs up. if p99 not back to baseline in 30m, escalate to runtime team for kernel-level investigation.

incident-bot: reminder: annotate incident with "mitigation-applied" and list config diffs.

maya: done. added diffs to incident: opsctl+kubectl steps + config keys changed. next update in 12m. :mag:
